translations.web: These sought their place among those who were registered by genealogy, but they were not found: therefore were they deemed disqualified and removed from the priesthood.
translations.bsb: These men searched for their family records, but they could not find them and so were excluded from the priesthood as unclean.
translations.kjv: These sought their register among those that were reckoned by genealogy, but they were not found: therefore were they, as polluted, put from the priesthood.
